name: What are common signs that my deck needs repair?
description: Look for loose boards, unstable railings, rot, splinters, or structural sagging. Early detection can prevent extensive damage.

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my deck needs repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs your deck needs repair include loose or rotting boards, unstable railings, noticeable splinters, corrosion on fasteners, or a faded and worn finish. Water damage, insect infestation, or visible structural issues like sagging joists also indicate a need for professional assessment. Identifying these issues early can prevent more extensive and costly repairs down the line.
